'''Figg Avenue''' was a street located in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] just off the [[Administrative Levels]]. It was named after [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]]. The street had [[K'cri's Cafe]] located there.
